text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I can run anywhere… Anywhere at all…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: There's nothing beneath my feet… No ground, nothing… I'm simply sliding… over the cogs…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Oh? You find the fact that I don't get exhausted during races… strange?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, I do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Over in one of the classrooms, Eishin Flash has confronted Manhattan Cafe with an abrupt assertion.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I've counted your wins, Cafe. You tend to compete in long-distance races, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Normally, the rate at which racers fall behind is perfectly proportional to how much energy they have left…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: But in your case, Cafe, that doesn't seem to happen.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: You never stop. You never slow down. It's as if you are unfettered by rules or restrictions…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: You are akin to… the Gespenst… A being of the void, that wanders endlessly…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I do not wish for my plans to go awry. Please perform in line with your potential.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure… whether I can do that…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um… If you'd like to know how I've gotten this far with long-distance races…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I think it has to do with my nails…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes… Long-distance races aren't as demanding on my nails as short-distance ones, which require quick bursts of energy.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I've also made an effort to run without putting my nails at risk, just like my trainer told me…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I think these factors have helped me cut down on a lot of wear and tear…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: In trying to escape an inescapable restraint, I found myself heading in a better direction…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a flaw she's had since birth. And perhaps she's found a way to use that flaw to her advantage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But if I were to really use my imagination…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maybe Manhattan Cafe's very existence is so faint that it's escaped the laws of gravity. …It's like she's a spirit.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Magnificent work, Manhattan Cafe! You have conquered more than two long-distance races!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And for that, I present to you this award! Bravo!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you… very much. I'll do my very best to accomplish more…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like, to Manhattan Cafe, distance is nothing to be feared.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Magnificent work, Manhattan Cafe! You have conquered more than four long-distance races!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And for that, I present to you this award! I applaud your fervent efforts! I wish you only the best!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you… very much.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I do find it strange sometimes… that the other runners around me fall back and disappear from sight…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe has become a contender to be taken seriously. No longer is she "the girl always standing in last."

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Magnificent work, Manhattan Cafe! You have conquered more than six long-distance races!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And for that, I present to you this award! You have become a legend! You are unbeatable! Stupendous!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you… very much.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I'm not me anymore. Sometimes, I feel as if it's my soul that's doing all the running…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe is already on her way to liberation from whatever was holding her back… and now she stands at a landmark achievement.
